name: The Little Bride with a Price
original_name: The Little Bride with a Price
overview: After losing his family in a plane crash, Chumon takes in Ploy, the daughter of the crashed pilot Chatchai, expecting her to repay him with her entire life. Ten years later, Ploy has grown into an adult, and Chumon's hatred for her gradually turns into love. Caught in a tangle of love and hate, the two hurt each other while also protecting one another, again and again, until finally coming together.
